sources.title: Realistic Synthetic Financial Transactions for Anti-Money Laundering Models
supports: legitimate and illicit activity in the same transaction network
sources.limitations: Conceptual reference only; no fitted parameters or copied simulator implementation.
Motifs support test scenarios, not real-world prevalence estimates.

assumptions.population: Five illustrative countries: US, MX, GB, DE, BR with customer weights 0.35/0.25/0.15/0.15/0.10. Country weights and bank mixes are invented; accounts are domestic to customer residence.
assumptions.activity: Lognormal account activity weights; weekday, month-end and payday multipliers are illustrative.
assumptions.amounts: Segment-dependent lognormal USD-equivalent amounts, with household/business and purpose adjustments; not fitted.
assumptions.relationships: Synthetic common ownership, domestic household/corporate groups and persistent preferred counterparties; 90% domestic preference draws, before self-transfer correction.
assumptions.fx: Fixed illustrative local-currency units per USD; not historical rates or prices.
assumptions.time: Country representative IANA timezone; intraday preference uses opening-date UTC offset (no DST calendar), no holidays.
assumptions.aml: Four-edge motifs, shared with benign controls; minority fraction is configurable, not an observed rate.
assumptions.funding: No balance ledger, external funding or settlement model in v0.1; outgoing amounts are not balance-constrained.
assumptions.account_history: All accounts predate the observation window. Historical features have a cold start at the window boundary.
